scope: External paper and chapter references supplied for the EEV4 evidence surface.
snapshot_policy: Metadata and SHA-256 provenance are registered; source PDFs are not vendored.

references.title: Restriction estimates using decoupling theorems and two-ends Furstenberg inequalities
references.use: Restriction and decoupling background in R^3, including a p > 22/7 restriction estimate built from decoupling and two-ends Furstenberg inequalities.
references.claim_boundary: This is bound-producing theorem background; it does not provide exact Riemann zero placement or a Kakeya-to-Riemann carrier.

references.title: Hilbert-Schmidt Orthogonality of det(ρ) and det(ρPT) over the Two-Rebit Systems ρ and Further Determinantal Moment Analyses
references.use: A bounded comparative example involving Hilbert-Schmidt measure, determinant moments, and orthogonality language.
references.claim_boundary: This domain-specific two-rebit analysis is not a general Hilbert-Schmidt theorem, a Kakeya result, or evidence for an exact Xi-realizing operator.

references.title: Volume estimates for unions of convex sets, and the Kakeya set conjecture in three dimensions
references.use: Primary theorem background for full Minkowski and Hausdorff dimension of Kakeya sets in R^3.
references.claim_boundary: The R^3 Kakeya theorem does not by itself prove RH; sufficient Kakeya-implies-RH packaging remains CLOSED.

references.title: iPiano: Inertial Proximal Algorithm for Nonconvex Optimization
references.use: External grounding for controlled inertial or heavy-ball-style dynamics through a descent and convergence architecture.
references.claim_boundary: EEV4 beta continuity is a governance quantity, not the iPiano momentum parameter; the paper does not validate EEV4 factors or mathematical bridge claims.

references.title: The Krein spectral shift and rank one perturbations of spectra
references.use: Operator-theoretic background for Krein spectral shift and self-adjoint rank-one perturbations.
references.claim_boundary: General rank-one perturbation theory does not supply the required prime weights, Gamma-factor density, or an exact Xi-realizing carrier.

references.title: A streamlined proof of the Kakeya set conjecture in R^3

source_snapshot.provided_name: LARRY GUTH, HONG WANG, AND JOSHUA ZAHL Abstract. We present a streamlined and simplified proof of the Kakeya set conjecture in R3.pdf

references.use: Streamlined theorem-background presentation of the Kakeya set conjecture in R^3.
references.claim_boundary: The streamlined proof concerns Kakeya in R^3 and does not close RH, the Coleman Conjecture, or the faithful kappa bridge.

references.title: Spectral determinants
references.venue: Chaos: Classical and Quantum, version 14, Chapter 19
references.use: Background on spectral determinants, trace formulas, dynamical zeta functions, and evolution-operator spectra.
references.claim_boundary: This chapter supplies vocabulary and examples, not a rigorous EEV4 operator realization or a proof that a proposed determinant equals Xi.
